title: Beam Search as Test-Time Self-Distillation via Counterfactual Contexts
abstract: arXiv:2609.37041v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) enables a language model to act as its own teacher: by conditioning on a demonstration, the model produces an implicit reward via pointwise mutual information, which guides on-policy learning without external supervision. However, SDFT operates at training time: it requires gradient updates and access to expert demonstrations, making it inapplicable at inference. We propose test-time self-distillation, a decoding-time method that extracts a steering signal from the self-distillation framework without any parameter updates, reward models, or training data. Our key insight is that counterfactual contexts, i.e. fixed textual templates that hypothetically prime the model for excellent versus poor reasoning, can substitute for the demonstration. translated_title: 基于反事实上下文的束搜索作为测试时自蒸馏
translated_abstract: 自蒸馏微调（SDFT）使语言模型能够充当自己的老师：通过以示范（demonstration）为条件，模型通过逐点互信息产生隐式奖励，从而在无需外部监督的情况下引导在线策略学习。然而，SDFT 在训练阶段运行：它需要梯度更新并需要访问专家示范，这使其无法应用于推理阶段。我们提出测试时自蒸馏（test-time self-distillation），这是一种解码时方法，能够从自蒸馏框架中提取引导信号，而无需任何参数更新、奖励模型或训练数据。我们的关键洞察是，反事实上下文——即假设性地使模型分别处于优秀推理与糟糕推理状态的固定文本模板——可以替代示范的作用。候选答案在这两种反事实条件下的对数几率比（log-odds ratio）定义了一种新的奖励信号。我们推导了在……下的最优 KL 正则化策略（原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出“测试时自蒸馏”这一解码时方法，利用反事实上下文模板替代专家示范，通过候选答案在两种反事实条件下的对数几率比构建新的奖励信号，使束搜索无需参数更新、奖励模型或训练数据即可引导语言模型生成更好的推理结果。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes test-time self-distillation, a decoding-time method that substitutes demonstrations with counterfactual contexts, using the log-odds ratio of candidate answers under good-versus-poor reasoning priming as a reward signal to steer beam search without any parameter updates, reward models, or training data.
